label: 1. Are you that commander I've been hearing about?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Are you that commander I've been hearing about?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I have a favor to ask of you.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I hope you will be receptive to it.
Ingrid?
Who is this?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Who is that?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Can't you see my username?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: If you're making assumptions based on the word "tactical" being in there,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: then you're sorely mistaken.
... Anyway, let's just act as if we don't know each other.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: That is not important.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: In exchange for helping me with this request,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I will see to it that you are compensated handsomely.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Now, may I continue?
... Ingrid really seems to be relishing this, so I'll play along.
What's this request you speak of?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: A mass-produced Nikke that was maintained by Elysion has escaped.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: She was recently deployed on a mission up to the surface,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: but upon the issuance of a return order,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: she apparently went AWOL.
Would she have a compelling reason to do so?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I have my own suspicions, but I cannot say anything with any certainty.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: She was always proactive on the field, and never had any real complaints.
Does this happen often?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Not often, but it does occur on occasion,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: and usually only shortly after someone has become a Nikke.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Typically as a result of feelings of despair, alienation, and more derived from their recent transformation.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: But this time is different.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Despite being a mass-produced Nikke, she has successfully returned from five separate missions on the surface.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: This is an astonishing high survival rate,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: and indicates that she is exceptionally skilled for a mass-produced model.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: She has also demonstrated remarkable initiative on the field,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: to the extent that she was scheduled to receive dedicated armaments soon.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: She is a highly tactical soldier,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: and I am at a loss as to why she would choose to go AWOL.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I would chase after her myself,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: but as you know, the Ark can't afford to be deploying troops outside the city.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Only a special detached unit such as yourselves will be able to pursue.
Okay, we'll do what we can.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: We're still picking up her ID signal.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: That tells us that she's still alive.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I'll give you the coordinates shortly.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Thank you for doing this.
